subtasks.title: Bypass ScanTimezoneScope on the activity aggregate + pin with a query-shape test
subtasks.approach: In app/Console/Commands/CloseInactiveShiftsCommand.php latestActivityFor(), add ->withoutGlobalScope(ScanTimezoneScope::class) to the Scan::query()->where('kit_id',...)->max('scanned_at') chain (import App\Models\Scopes\ScanTimezoneScope). Keep ShowVisibleScan (is_visible=true). Then add a feature test that enables the zod query log, runs scout:close-inactive-shifts with a seeded open shift + stale visible scan, and asserts no executed query matches /timezones|ST_Within/i while the shift still closes correctly.
subtasks.intended_diffs: Command: import ScanTimezoneScope; change the $latestScan query to `Scan::query()->withoutGlobalScope(ScanTimezoneScope::class)->where('kit_id',$kitId)->max('scanned_at')`. Test: add latest_activity_lookup_does_not_join_timezones() using DB::connection('zod')->enableQueryLog(), asserting no logged query contains 'timezones' or 'ST_Within' and the shift is closed with end_type=Assumed.

notes: No platform migration (scans is zod-managed). No blast-radius globs touched. Sizing: 2 files, one concern — no split.
